title.rendered: Hawks View Annual Food Drive  December 3-12

content.rendered:
Our annual food drive is just around the corner and will run December 3-12.  All food and toys will go to the Sherwood Elks, which will all be distributed right back into our community.  Our goal this year is to collect 6,000 items.  Click on the link to the flyer below for details.

Spanish flyer HERE.

English flyer HERE.
